collection.title: Work Place Safety - Evacuation Chairs & Stretchers
collection.description:
Evacuation Chairs and Evacuation Stretchers

Evacuation Chairs and Evacuation Stretchers are used to safely evacuate people from multi-story buildings. They are important safety equipment for use in the event of fire, earthquake, blackouts, or medical emergencies. Evacuation chairs are critical for evacuating non-ambulatory persons down stairs, especially in high rise buildings.

Emergency evacuation chairs and evacuation stretchers are essential tools for safely evacuating individuals in emergency situations, especially from multistory buildings. Evacuation supplies are equally important for health care facilities who need to mobilize incapacitated patients in a crisis, and to employers who need to ensure their employees can be safely evacuated during a disaster.

Evacuation supplies from EVAC+CHAIR and Anchortex Corporation ensure fast rescue and evacuation of all personnel when needed. Evacuation chairs and similar rescue equipment from EVAC+CHAIR and Rapid Extraction (REX) are the original and best solution for emergency evacuation of individuals who are injured, disabled, or otherwise in need of assistance. These products are designed for simplicity so that they can be used without training or instructions if necessary, with no add-ons or features that may break or snag in a crisis. Evacuation equipment from leading brands like Evac+Chair and Rapid Extraction (REX) provide innovative solutions for emergency evacuations.

Evacuation chairs are specially designed devices used to evacuate individuals with mobility impairments, such as those who use wheelchairs or have difficulty walking, during emergencies such as fires, earthquakes, or other disasters. These chairs feature sturdy construction, easy-to-use mechanisms, and ergonomic design to ensure the safe and swift evacuation of individuals from multi-story buildings or confined spaces.

Evac+Chair is a globally recognized brand that specializes in the design and manufacture of evacuation chairs and stair chairs. Evac-Chair's range of emergency stair evacuation chairs includes models suitable for different building layouts and occupant needs,. This ensures there is a solution for every evacuation scenario. Evac+Chair's innovative features, such as glide belts and tracked evacuation chairs, make them a trusted choice for facilities worldwide seeking reliable and efficient stair evacuation solutions.
